mentions.name: Asteria 4X
mentions.description: A 4X space strategy game inspired by the 1995 classic Stars!, cloning its core gameplay while adding the builder's own touches and lots of high sci-fi concepts. Already fun to play, with early access coming soon on Steam.
mentions.source_excerpt: When I was a kid I loved a game called "Stars!" from 1995. I cloned the core and I'm also adding my own touch and lots of high sci-fi concepts. Already fun to play, early access coming soon: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5482440/Asteria_4X
mentions.author: zulban
